title: Diary entry frontmatter
description: Single source of truth for entry frontmatter. The generator validates against this file as a guard before opening a PR; the Astro content collection validates against the same file at build time. Neither side keeps a second copy of these rules.

day.description: Ebner's in-world day count. Strictly increasing across entries, but not consecutive: gaps are normal.

location.description: Entity id of the place where the entry ends. References entities.id.

kind.description: Entry kind. Picked by the randomiser; quiet covers days when nothing happened.

tone.description: Tone the randomiser drew for this entry. Recorded for the same reason `kind` is: it is a drawn parameter the next draw has to know about, since melancholy may not run twice in a row. Optional — entries written before the draw existed carry none.

threads.description: Thread ids this entry touches. Shown to the reader as "sprawy".

image.description: R2 object key of the sketch, or null when the entry has none.
